title: The F-35 Should Have Been the F-24

lines.text: The F-35 should have been called the F-24.
Since nineteen sixty-two, American military aircraft names have followed one system.
Under its rules, the next new fighter after the YF-23 should have taken the next number in line: twenty-four.
Instead, the winning demonstrator, the X-35, simply kept its number.
And the F-35 is far from the only aircraft name that breaks the rules.
